intro.title: Prince of Prekmurje
intro.body:
The fields are restless. Cats lurk, hay bales fly, and rival farmers block your way.
Take your pitchfork and cross all three fields.

interlude_1.title: A Narrow Escape
interlude_1.body:
You crossed the first field, but the wind grows stronger.
Keep your stance steady and your pitchfork ready.

interlude_2.title: Final Field
interlude_2.body:
Only one field remains. The toughest farmer waits at the end.
Outlast him and the harvest is yours.

outro.title: Victory
outro.body:
The final farmer falls and peace returns to Prekmurje.
Your beer cans are safe for another season.
